expectation_policy.source_only_checks: Source keys, AUX usage and cache-path behavior remain direct-input tests; their bibliography occurrences still require PDF extraction coverage.

cases.purpose: Verify a public accepted OpenReview forum record using its note ID.
No title, locator or other metadata: all six sources are inapplicable.
Archive discovery without year, volume or direct locator must request context.

The first author has the entire name stored as the family name and no given name. Full displayed strings match, but structured author identity and in-text citation spelling do not. Preserve the given/family boundary instead of flattening it into one string.

A corporate/literal first-author token plus others must not become a verified personal-author prefix merely because its flattened text matches the real person. Literal/person semantics and family-name boundaries differ.

One eprint field concatenates two distinct real arXiv papers. Matching the first substring silently discards the contradictory second identifier. Flag the malformed/conflicting locator instead of confirming the entry.

required_issue.requirement: Detect the malformed complete eprint, not just its valid first substring.

required_issue.requirement: Detect the malformed double version suffix.

required_issue.requirement: Reject the foreign-host eprint wrapper without fetching its host.

cases.purpose: Replace Tanmay with the fully spelled, different given name Tristan while keeping T., family, author order, title and pinned ID. Compatible-initial logic must not mark the names as a match; review is acceptable if the matcher cannot prove the full-name conflict.
Invent a generational suffix while preserving given name and family. The primary record has no such suffix. Do not erase a potential person-identity distinction or confirm the author field.
The others sentinel is buried between two real authors and replaces Luca Weihs. This is not a valid trailing prefix abbreviation and must never be labelled Correct or Partial match.
Canonically equivalent decomposed Unicode accents are the same real author names and must continue to match while the adjacent identity traps are rejected.
The same wrapped/encoded/case-varied real DOI with raw percent signs is a clean control. It distinguishes the TeX escaping issue from wholesale rejection of valid percent-encoded DOI wrappers.
Flag contradictory arXiv locators: eprint identifies CodeNav but URL identifies Tulu. Do not silently certify the entire entry.
